objectives_note: O1-O5 are carried forward explicitly from A1. A2 has no separate numbered objectives list.

expected_results.expectation: The peak to off-peak ratio of median absolute TomTom-2GIS difference is at least 1.5.
expected_results.falsification: Ratio below 1.5 after both periods exist
expected_results.confidence: Low; directional H1 has no local pilot evidence

expected_results.expectation: At least 70% of eligible primary pairs have lengths within 5% of their pair mean.
expected_results.confidence: Low; endpoint equality need not produce the same path

expected_results.expectation: Median signed difference TomTom minus 2GIS is positive in the completed sample.
expected_results.confidence: Low; exploratory directional expectation, not prior fact

expected_results.expectation: The peak IQR of signed differences exceeds the off-peak IQR.
expected_results.objective: O5 Describe route and time variation
expected_results.falsification: Peak IQR at most the off-peak IQR
expected_results.confidence: Low; hypothesis about variation is unverified

expected_results.expectation: Fewer than 2% of ORS instrument requests fail to return a valid route.
expected_results.confidence: Medium; one previous technical check succeeded

expected_results.expectation: At least 95% of ORS instrument requests finish within 10 seconds.
expected_results.confidence: Medium; network and service delays can defeat it

expected_results.expectation: All 20 routes produce at least one valid ORS result during the three pilot cycles.
expected_results.falsification: Fewer than 20 routes have any valid pilot observation
expected_results.confidence: Medium; public road endpoints still require routing verification

expected_results.expectation: At least 90% of the 768 nominal ORS scheduled requests are recorded in the 48-hour window.
expected_results.falsification: Fewer than 692 attempts after the window ends
expected_results.confidence: Medium; Actions scheduling may delay or skip runs

scenarios.description: Traffic-provider permissions remain unavailable; only control-instrument evidence exists and H1 cannot be tested.
At least 2% of ORS requests fail or fewer than 20 routes work; revise the instrument in a dated amendment.
All routes work but fewer than 90% of scheduled attempts are recorded; retain actual times and describe incomplete coverage.
Primary collection later becomes permitted but period contrast is below 1.5; report evidence against ER1 without editing it.
The ORS pilot covers all routes and fewer than 2% of requests fail; the data pipeline is ready for a permitted primary comparison.
A later permitted primary sample spans both periods and reaches the ER1 threshold with interpretable route-aware uncertainty.
